items.summary: NIHがRetham Technologies社(ウィスコンシン州)に$4.6Mを助成し、ヘパリン起因性血小板減少症(HIT)の早期・高精度検出のための体外診断アッセイ開発を支援するSBIR Phase IIプロジェクト。
items.verbatim: AN IN VITRO DIAGNOSTIC ASSAY FOR THE EARLY AND ACCURATE DETECTION OF PLATELET-ACTIVATING ANTIBODIES ASSOCIATED WITH HEPARIN-INDUCED THROMBOCYTOPENIA - PROJECT SUMMARY/ABSTRACT THIS PHASE II SBIR PROPOSAL IS AIMED AT DEVELOPING A HIGHLY ACCURATE FUNCTIONAL IN VITRO DIAGNOSTIC (IVD) ASSAY FOR THE DETE

items.summary: 米ウィスコンシン州WEDCがWauwatosaのRetham Technologies, Inc.(NAICS 325413:診断薬等製造)に$49,250を助成、計画投資額は$246,250。
items.infer: 診断薬・生化学製品関連の製造設備投資である可能性(推論)。製造ラインの新設・拡張であれば、充填・検査・包装装置など精密加工機器の需要につながる可能性(推論)。
items.verbatim: WEDC Grant under the Wisconsin Investment Pilot Program program, awarded 2021-05-18 to a recipient in City of Wauwatosa, Milwaukee County. Industry: Manufacturing (NAICS 325413). Award amount: $49,250. Planned project cost: $246,250.
